# watchpoint_scheduled_report (Data Source)

Looks up a single scheduled report by name within the tenant.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "watchpoint_scheduled_report" "example" {
  name = "Weekly Uptime Report"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the scheduled report to look up (case-insensitive).

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp (RFC 3339).
- `id` (String) Report ID.
- `is_enabled` (Boolean) Whether the report is on a recurring schedule (true unless the cadence is `None`).
- `report_kind` (String) Delivery cadence of the report: `None`, `Daily`, `Weekly`, or `Monthly`.
